info.title: Arbitrum JSON-RPC (spike)
info.description: Hand-written mini OpenAPI 3.1 document. One fake path per JSON-RPC method.

post.description: Returns the block number and the raw block metadata of each block in the range from `fromBlock` to `toBlock` that has metadata. Returns an error if the node does not serve block metadata, if `fromBlock` is greater than `toBlock`, or if the range exceeds the configured block limit.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Returns an error if the transaction publisher of the node, such as its <Term id="sequencer">sequencer</Term> or its <Term id="forwarder">transaction forwarder</Term>, is not healthy. Returns `null` otherwise.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

type PricingModelHistory struct {
	Start            uint64     `json:"start"`
	End              uint64     `json:"end"`
	Step             uint64     `json:"step"`
	Timestamp        []uint64   `json:"timestamp"`
	BaseFee          []*big.Int `json:"baseFee"`
	GasBacklog       []uint64   `json:"gasBacklog"`
	GasUsed          []uint64   `json:"gasUsed"`
	MinBaseFee       *big.Int   `json:"minBaseFee"`
	SpeedLimit       uint64     `json:"speedLimit"`
	PerBlockGasLimit uint64     `json:"perBlockGasLimit"`
	PerTxGasLimit    uint64     `json:"perTxGasLimit"`
	PricingInertia   uint64     `json:"pricingInertia"`
	BacklogTolerance uint64     `json:"backlogTolerance"`

	L1BaseFeeEstimate      []*big.Int `json:"l1BaseFeeEstimate"`
	L1LastSurplus          []*big.Int `json:"l1LastSurplus"`
	L1FundsDue             []*big.Int `json:"l1FundsDue"`
	L1FundsDueForRewards   []*big.Int `json:"l1FundsDueForRewards"`
	L1UnitsSinceUpdate     []uint64   `json:"l1UnitsSinceUpdate"`
	L1LastUpdateTime       []uint64   `json:"l1LastUpdateTime"`
	L1EquilibrationUnits   *big.Int   `json:"l1EquilibrationUnits"`

	L1AmortizedCostCapBips uint64     `json:"l1AmortizedCostCapBips"`
	L1PricingInertia       uint64     `json:"l1PricingInertia"`
	L1PerUnitReward        uint64     `json:"l1PerUnitReward"`
	L1PayRewardTo          string     `json:"l1PayRewardTo"`
}

post.description: Returns the size of the <Term id="retryable-ticket">retryable</Term> timeout queue at evenly spaced blocks between `start` and `end`, with at most the configured block range bound of samples.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Returns the <Term id="retryable-ticket">retryable tickets</Term> in the timeout queue at the given block, with the timeout of each queue entry in Unix seconds, or 0 if the retryable no longer exists. Returns at most one entry more than the configured timeout queue bound.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Adds the signed transaction to the transaction pool, waits until it is included in a block, and returns the receipt. Returns an error if the timeout ends first.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.
